title: Scale
promise: Current, not stale, at any memory size, without making every prompt slower or longer.
question: As unrelated decisions pile up, does the Claude Code hook still inject only current values, still find them, and stay small and fast?
method: 44 scored decision histories (41 changed-fact questions) interleaved in time with N unrelated decisions (N = 0, 250, 500, 1000, 2000), all stored through handle_memory_store; questions asked through http_server._prompt_context (the hook) and BM25 over every stored turn (top 5). Lexical mode.
deterministic_note: Scores are deterministic; latency and ingest time are wall-clock on this machine.

headline.label: Outdated values injected with 2,000 unrelated decisions in memory

metrics.name: Hook stale exposure
metrics.definition: Changed-fact questions whose injected context contains an outdated value, at N=2,000.

metrics.name: Hook current-value hit
metrics.definition: Changed-fact questions whose injected context contains the current value, at N=2,000.

metrics.name: BM25 stale exposure (baseline)
metrics.definition: Same questions, BM25 top 5 over every stored turn, at N=2,000.

metrics.name: Hook latency p95
metrics.definition: 95th percentile wall time of one prompt-hook call (warm).

metrics.name: Median injected context
metrics.definition: Median characters the hook adds to a prompt.

metrics.name: Ingest cost
metrics.definition: Mean wall time of handle_memory_store per stored turn.

limits: Distractors are template-generated, single-valued decisions; real memories also change and carry longer free text.
Lexical mode only; semantic mode would add embedding cost per turn.
Measures what the hook injects, not the model's final answer.
Latency is one machine, one process, warm cache.
findings: Current-value hit falls from 31/41 to 17/41 at 2,000 unrelated decisions while storage stays correct (34/34 slots resolved). Diagnosed at 7ce571a, Logic: the hook scores only the 500 newest live claims (memcontext/http_server.py:768 _TOOL_CONTEXT_ROW_LIMIT, applied at :777), so an older current decision is never a candidate.

1/51 prompts get a false CONFLICT warning at 2,000 decisions. Diagnosed at 7ce571a, Logic: unprefixed subjects all share prefix '' and a subset of topic words counts as the same decision, so 'message queue' matches 'inventory worker message queue' (memcontext/conflicts.py:44).

Hook p95 latency grows from 2.66 ms to 273.12 ms. Diagnosed at 7ce571a, Implementation: each injected candidate re-reads every live claim of its predicate and regex-compares subjects (memcontext/conflicts.py:51 live_same_kind, called per candidate from memcontext/http_server.py:550 _with_conflicts).

Ingest cost per stored turn grows from 1.96 ms to 25.78 ms (linear per store, quadratic in total). Diagnosed at 7ce571a, Implementation: the subject-drift warning rescans every live subject and recomputes corpus word statistics on every store (memcontext/mcp_tools.py:117 _subject_drift -> memcontext/conflicts.py:227 similar_subjects, :207 _corpus_common_words); importance.recompute_all_importance (memcontext/on_new_turn.py:326) rescans all claims periodically.
